verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's docs are built for agents: a root llms.txt (confirmed live at HTTP 200 by probe) links to per-product llms.txt indexes, and there is a whole-corpus llms-full.txt. Every page is also available as Markdown via an /index.md mirror or an `Accept: text/markdown` header. On top of that, a dedicated agent-setup hub and a keyless Documentation MCP server (confirmed live by probe) let agents consume the docs directly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix
Every docs page also carries "Copy as Markdown", "View as Markdown", and "Agent setup" links.
a live remote MCP server usable with NO credentials at all
